metadata.qos: ServicesQoS reliable volatile KeepLast(max(16,window)); intra-process disabled
metadata.scheduling: application and one native wait thread, plus RMW threads, on the same fixed CPU; task versus manual-thread baseline and rclcpp single-thread executor; all languages and native/RMW threads share the same allowed CPU set [24, 25]
metadata.rtt_boundary: before async request through response retrieval, before sum validation; queueing inside the window included
metadata.throughput_boundary: complete measured requests including validation; excludes setup/discovery/warmup/teardown
metadata.cpu_boundary: process CPU clock across all threads inside the measured window, per completed request

build_manifest.executor_api_detection: nodes/executor.rs present: shared native wait; absent: Node native wait for one node and nonblocking round-robin for multiple nodes
build_manifest.executor_control_detection: nodes/executor/control.rs present: cancellation handle available; R2R_BENCH_CONTROL_ENABLED creates and retains a handle before measurement
build_manifest.background_api_detection: nodes/executor/background.rs present: Executor::spawn task; absent: manual native wait thread and join; R2R_BENCH_BACKGROUND_ENABLED selects runtime-independent block_on application driver
build_manifest.benchmark_cfg: --check-cfg declares shared_executor, executor_control and background_task; --cfg enables each only where its API exists
